notes.title: Name The Boss
notes.content:
Choose any name you want for the Final Boss in Riot Ride, best name out of all submissions wins!

About the boss:
An evil disco van that rams you with its disco ball and blows you up with its lasers!
For more info, check out the trailer (end part): https://youtu.be/5s7S7rseEcg

How To Submit A Name
[olist]
Join our Discord server  
Collect 2500 coins by playing chatting and playing fun games on the server
Buy the Nameplate item using /item buy Nameplate
!use the item!
Write the name in ⁠the #final-boss-nameplate channel!
[/olist]

What the name can be

The name must be something related to the description of the boss (A disco van basically), get creative!
The name must abide by the rules of our Discord server (no hate, racism, sexism...)
The name mustn't be trademarked!


Time for some fun and creative names, join now!
